description:
That RED door says it all...welcome to Tarzana's most irresistible, fully remodeled home. This stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers approximately 1,700 square feet of beautifully upgraded living space, showcasing quality craftsmanship and thoughtful finishes throughout.
Step inside to a light-filled interior featuring new laminate flooring, recessed lighting throughout, and fresh interior and exterior paint. The inviting living area is anchored by a stylishly updated fireplace(a must see), creating the perfect space to relax or entertain. The brand-new kitchen is a true highlight, complete with sleek finishes and updated appliances, seamlessly flowing into the dining and living areas.  Both bathrooms have been fully renovated with a clean, modern aesthetic. Additional upgrades include new windows, shutter blinds, a new water heater (2026), and central A/C and heating replaced in April 2023...providing comfort and peace of mind. 
The outdoor space is equally impressive. The front and backyard feature drought-tolerant landscaping designed for beauty and very low maintenance. Enjoy your own private backyard retreat with a beautifully refinished pool (2021), new pump and filter, solar heating, and an added ozone filtration system. The property also boasts new concrete, new fencing, and a new pool fence...ideal for both entertaining and everyday enjoyment.  With a newer roof (approximately 8 years old), no HOA, new Sleek Remote 2-car garage door and an extensive list of upgrades rarely found in one home, this property is truly move-in ready.
A home of this caliber in Tarzana is a rare find....this is a must-see and will not last.
